metadata.title: Team Main Bhi Bharat in Odisha's Mayurbhanj
metadata.description:
Our team is currently touring Odisha's northern region. We are working hard to prepare ground reports, and episodes of The Tribal Kitchen, and bring you lots of stories from there. 

Here's a little glimpse of the kind of reports and stories that Shyam Sunder is preparing for you.

Watch this space for all the updates.

#Main_Bhi_Bharat #Odisha
